links.comparator_used: Conventional supervised model trained on the first period and not updated (static), also benchmarked against in-context learning and hybrid approaches
links.outcome: F1 drop under label-set incompatibility and task definition evolution after incremental retraining
links.effect: Static supervised models dropped up to 82% F1 in LSI and 43% in TDE; continual adaptation with incremental retraining gradually restored performance and surpassed in-context and hybrid approaches after at least 30% of second-period data
links.tradeoff: Needs newly labeled data from the second period (at least 30%) to surpass in-context and hybrid approaches; with little new data it performs worse than them
links.quote: Continual adaptation with incremental retraining gradually restored performance, but only surpassed in-context and hybrid approaches after incorporating at least 30% of data from the second period.

links.comparator_used: Off-the-shelf LLM with in-context learning (no adaptation to new data)
links.outcome: Recovery of baseline F1 after shift
links.effect: Continual training only surpassed in-context and hybrid approaches after incorporating at least 30% of data from the second period; below that, in-context learning was better
links.tradeoff: Requires labeled data from the new period and retraining; in-context learning needs no new labeled data
links.quote: Continual adaptation with incremental retraining gradually restored performance, but only surpassed in-context and hybrid approaches after incorporating at least 30% of data from the second period.

design_hint: model adaptation to dataset shift (continual retraining vs in-context learning)
